correctness.rationale: For X=|Gaussian|/norm, direct gamma monomial moments of degrees ≤4 give stated B0 and B1. S_d coordinate permutation representation splits exactly as 3 trivial + 3(d−1) standard + d(d−3)/2 edge-incidence kernel; full sphere basis functions are orthonormal and total dimension d(d+3)/2. Eigenvalues strictly between 0 and 1 because no quadratic polynomial vanishes on an open orthant or its complement. A delta method for S_d gives centered variance 1−3/π; conditional quadratic residual has norm 2ν², forcing symmetric-block min ~(π−3)^2/(2d²) and max ~2d²/π², while the standard block has min Ω(d^(−1)), giving κ∼[2/(π(π−3))]d². Independently evaluated reduced spectra at d=4,5,6,10,30,100,500, including κ(d=4)=387.23607; original checker.py independently forms full monomial Gram matrices for d=3..9. Finite checks do not establish asymptotics.

evidence: Simons–Dahlen–Wieczorek and Michel–Plattner–Seibert give general spherical concentration integral/kernel matrices; no evaluated all-d orthant three-block spectrum in inspected sections.
